name: Martin's Furniture
old_description: Check out these products from our most popular categories of furniture.
about:
Martin's Furniture is a family-owned business based in Ephrata, Pennsylvania, operated by Marlin and his family. The company runs a retail showroom and a workshop where it produces custom furniture, upholstery, and finishing work alongside a curated selection of branded lines.

The store carries collections from makers such as Zimmerman Chair, Lancaster Legacy, Barkman Furniture, Buckeye Seating, and Grand Slabs, offering dining tables, counter chairs, porch furniture, and live-edge slabs paired with steel bases. In-house capabilities include custom furniture design, custom upholstery, custom finishing, and the fabrication of live-edge tables and replacement parts. A white-glove delivery service handles professional handling, room-of-choice placement, assembly, setup, and packaging removal.

Customers range from homeowners furnishing primary residences to buyers seeking heirloom-quality pieces; testimonials cite a 2.5-hour drive from New Jersey for dining sets, same-day replacement parts for a 20-year-old glider, and custom butcher-block countertops in multiple hardwoods. The shop serves both retail walk-ins and custom-order clients.

The company emphasizes handcrafted construction using sustainably sourced hardwoods and Amish-built pieces, positioning its white-glove service and in-house customization as key differentiators for buyers who want tailored, durable furniture without managing multiple vendors.
